title: Who remembers the anniversary
old_caption:
Which sign remembers your anniversary down to the hour?
Ranked. Forgot? Own it, then plan something sweet.

title: Who gets the most excited for snow
old_caption:
Who's outside before the first snowflake lands?
All twelve signs, ranked by snow joy. Find someone that excited to see you.

title: Who loves the hardest
old_caption:
We tried to rank who loves the hardest. It didn't go to plan.
Every sign loves hard, just differently.

title: Who takes being left on read the hardest
old_caption:
One read receipt, twelve completely different breakdowns. Pisces wrote a poem about it.
Stay for the twist at the end. Where are you on the board?

title: Who asks “what are we?” first
old_caption:
Somebody has to ask “so what are we?” Aries asked at the door on date one.
Who in your life would schedule the talk for Q1?

title: Who gives great advice and never takes it
old_caption:
The group chat's best advice-giver, live: says “rest!” and colour-codes the rest.
Which advice do you give everyone but yourself?

title: Who misses their ex the most at 2 a.m.
old_caption:
2 a.m., the ex crosses your mind, and every sign handles it very differently. Capricorn has been asleep since ten.
Which one are you tonight?

title: Who makes the first move
old_caption:
Scorpio is waiting for a sign. Literally a sign. Aries already asked them out twice.
Are you a first-move person or a forty-drafts person?

title: Who’s the best at being single
old_caption:
Single season, ranked, all the way up to a solo trip through three cities. Grandma asks the big question at the end.
Which spot on the board is yours?

title: Aries plans ice skating at 7 AM
old_caption:
Would you go ice skating at 7 AM for someone?
Aries did laps. The date held the wall. Then Aries came back for their hand.
